lyrics:
[intro]
I was lost in the silence, searching for a sign
Chasing down a dream that was always mine
[verse]
Woke up under skies where the stars still shine
Got a fire in my soul, got a reason to climb
They said stay low, but I’m reaching high
A kid from the bottom learning how to fly
Lost some nights, but I found my way
Turned my doubts into brighter days
[chorus]
I keep dreaming big 'til the stars align
Young and fearless, yeah I’m crossing the line
Fire in my heart, running through my veins
From the dark to the light, rising through the rain
[verse]
Time keeps moving, so I move ahead
Breaking every wall, every word they said
No more waiting, I’m chasing the flame
Building my story, remembering my name
[chorus]
I keep dreaming big 'til the stars align
Young and fearless, yeah I’m crossing the line
Fire in my heart, running through my veins
From the dark to the light, rising through the rain
[bridge]
Every scar, every fall, made me who I am
Pressure made diamonds, now I understand
[chorus]
I keep dreaming big 'til the stars align
Young and fearless, yeah I’m crossing the line
Fire in my heart, running through my veins
From the dark to the light, rising through the rain
[outro]
